title: Build an installable Vulkan preview from latest stable Vape 4.4.3
objective: Integrate the proven Minecraft 26.2 native GPU renderer into the exact latest 4.4.3 client, preserve all UX/config/font/module fixes, and deliver a separately testable preview JAR only with verified fail-closed behavior for unsupported legacy paths.
acceptance_criteria: Candidate baseline is the exact 4.4.3 JAR SHA-256 045eed06564be1af11d1569f31d5cbdd34eb8f2058d01aa6384f1cfb969db7a6
Native 26.2 GPU GUI batches use original 32-float vertex ABI, original shader modes, texture identity, matrices, scissor and draw order
Vulkan mode never silently falls back to OpenGL; unsupported framebuffer/world callbacks fail closed and are reported
Run real Minecraft 26.2 OpenGL and Vulkan smoke tests; package candidate only with clear preview limitations
